# Push-T environment

The state-based Push-T environment and rendering helpers come from
[Diffusion Policy](https://github.com/real-stanford/diffusion_policy).
The MIT license is included in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

`src/tasks/pusht.py` provides the task adapter. It uses `legacy=True` to match
the demonstration dataset's reset convention. Install dependencies with
`requirements/pusht.txt` in the separate Push-T environment.
